name: W Bogota Hotel
insider_take: This ultra-modern W property brings Manhattan-style luxury to Colombia's vibrant capital, sitting in the heart of Zona Rosa where business meets Bogotá's legendary nightlife.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a prime spot in Zona Rosa, Bogotá's upscale business and entertainment district, just steps from world-class restaurants and rooftop bars. At 8,660 feet above sea level, you'll enjoy breathtaking Andean mountain views from the upper floors. The property features signature W amenities including the AWAY Spa and cutting-edge fitness center, plus easy access to Bogotá's Gold Museum - home to the world's largest collection of pre-Columbian gold artifacts.
pro_tip: Take advantage of the hotel's location for exploring La Candelaria historic district (20 minutes by taxi) in the morning, then return to Zona Rosa for dinner and cocktails - the altitude can be tiring, so having a luxury base nearby is essential.
dont_miss: The Sunday Ciclovía when over 75 miles of Bogotá's streets close to cars and transform into bike paths - rent a bike and join millions of locals. Also, the hotel's proximity to Andrés Carne de Res, Colombia's most famous restaurant, makes for an unforgettable dining experience just 30 minutes away in Chía.
pros: Prime location in Zona Rosa with easy access to shopping and dining
Contemporary W brand design with vibrant modern interiors
Rooftop terrace offering panoramic city views
Part of Marriott Luminous program with premium benefits
cons: Urban location may experience city noise
High-altitude location at 8,660 feet above sea level
